name: In the Heat of the Moment
source:
Iba eagerly waits for his father, Tsuyin, to come home from the gym so they can watch a movie together before he leaves on a business trip. When Tsuyin finally arrives, a brief altercation between them awakens something deep within Iba.

Compelled by these feelings, Iba starts exploring parts of his father’s life he’s never noticed before. His search uncovers a secret that tests his ability to keep calm, as his impulses begin to take the lead. All the while, his dad remains unaware that Iba has uncovered something hidden beneath the surface. How will Iba handle these revelations, and will his father ever discover that his secret is out?
